propositions: 119 */.archived and 126 */.write.lock files are tracked in tickets branch HEAD despite .gitignore patterns, causing git status to show dirty working-tree deletions and breaking plan-review head SHA validation
An idempotent ensure unit must remove tracked marker files from the git index without touching worktree copies, then run once per store convergence
Peers merging the untrack commit must have their worktree markers deleted by git while maintaining clean status and correct archive semantics
The ticket list reader must self-heal missing .archived markers for archived tickets by re-materializing them on demand rather than dirtying git status
